messages.content: 根据以上检索结果，用中文总结这个方向主要解决什么问题、有哪些技术路线。只使用当前材料，每个主要观点附论文引用。

以下基于当前论文摘要归纳，未经全文核验。 部分生成内容未通过引用或数字核验，以下仅保留通过的部分。

该方向主要解决大语言模型推理中预填充（prefill）与解码（decode）两个阶段特性不同导致的效率问题：预填充是计算密集型，解码是内存带宽密集型，二者相互干扰且资源需求不匹配。
[paper-011] · 摘要；[paper-012] · 摘要；[paper-013] · 摘要

技术路线之一是预填充-解码分离（PD disaggregation），将两个阶段放在不同硬件上运行以减少干扰，但会引入阶段不均衡和跨设备KV缓存传输开销。
[paper-012] · 摘要；[paper-013] · 摘要

技术路线之二是混合批处理与注意力内核优化，将不同请求的预填充和解码阶段合并到同一批次中，并设计能同时高效计算两阶段注意力的GPU内核。
[paper-011] · 摘要

技术路线之三是专用硬件设计，针对预填充和解读阶段的不同特性定制芯片，例如预填充芯片采用更大脉动阵列和低成本GDDR内存，解码芯片保留高内存带宽但降低计算能力。
[paper-012] · 摘要

技术路线之四是模型剪枝与预填充-解码分离结合，分析两阶段对剪枝的敏感度，识别各阶段可移除的块，实现更精确的剪枝。
[paper-009] · 摘要

技术路线之五是跨模型共享预填充模块与KV缓存，通过分解模型、冻结预填充模块并仅微调解码模块，使多个任务特定模型共享同一预填充模块和KV缓存。
[paper-010] · 摘要

技术路线之七是统一聚合与分离架构，根据SLO动态调整预填充-解码聚合或分离模式，在平衡SLO下采用混合模式优化有效吞吐量。
[paper-019] · 摘要

citations.title: POD-A ttention : Unlocking Full Prefill-Decode Overlap for Faster LLM Inference
citations.quote: Each request in LLM inference goes through two phases: compute-bound prefill and memory-bandwidth-bound decode.

citations.title: SPAD: Specialized Prefill and Decode Hardware for Disaggregated LLM Inference
citations.quote: LLM inference is composed of two phases with distinct characteristics: a compute-bound prefill phase followed by a memory-bound decode phase.

citations.title: PDAcc: A Prefill-Decode Disaggregated MCM-Based Accelerator for Multi-Task Large Language Model Applications
citations.quote: Prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation has emerged as a promising serving paradigm for large language models (LLMs), as it decouples prompt processing (prefill) from autoregressive token generation (decode) to reduce inter-task interference and improve quality of service (QoS).

citations.title: SPAD: Specialized Prefill and Decode Hardware for Disaggregated LLM Inference
citations.quote: prior work proposes prefill-decode disaggregation to run each phase on separate hardware.

citations.title: PDAcc: A Prefill-Decode Disaggregated MCM-Based Accelerator for Multi-Task Large Language Model Applications
citations.quote: However, disaggregation also amplifies stage imbalance: the prefill cluster (P-C) can become compute-limited, the decode cluster (D-C) is often bandwidth-limited, and the required cross-device KV cache transfer introduces additional communication overhead.

citations.title: POD-A ttention : Unlocking Full Prefill-Decode Overlap for Faster LLM Inference
citations.quote: recent systems use hybrid batching that combines the prefill and decode phases of different requests into the same batch.

citations.title: POD-A ttention : Unlocking Full Prefill-Decode Overlap for Faster LLM Inference
citations.quote: POD-Attention - the first GPU kernel that efficiently computes attention for hybrid batches.

citations.title: SPAD: Specialized Prefill and Decode Hardware for Disaggregated LLM Inference
citations.quote: SPAD (Specialized Prefill and Decode hardware), adopting a less-is-more methodology to design specialized chips tailored to the distinct characteristics of prefill and decode phases. The proposed Prefill Chips have larger systolic arrays and use cost-effective GDDR memory, whereas the proposed Decode Chips retain high memory bandwidth but reduce compute capacity.

citations.title: PDTrim: Targeted Pruning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Inference
citations.quote: we propose a pruning method that is highly integrated with PD disaggregation, enabling more precise pruning of blocks.

citations.title: PDTrim: Targeted Pruning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Inference
citations.quote: we analyze the pruning sensitivity of the prefill and decode stages and identify removable blocks specific to each stage, making it well suited for PD disaggregation deployment.

citations.title: PrefillShare: A Shared Prefill Module for KV Reuse in Multi-LLM Disaggregated Serving
citations.quote: PrefillShare factorizes the model into prefill and decode modules, freezes the prefill module, and fine-tunes only the decode module. This design allows multiple task-specific models to share a prefill module and the KV cache generated for the same prompt.

messages.content: 从当前结果中选择两篇最相关的论文，比较它们怎样划分 prefill 和 decode 资源、怎样处理负载变化，以及适用条件。材料没说明的请标为当前材料未说明。

以下基于当前论文摘要归纳，未经全文核验。 部分生成内容未通过引用或数字核验，以下仅保留通过的部分。

在给定材料中，与“划分 prefill 和 decode 资源”最直接相关的两篇是：一篇提出按工作负载比例把可重构芯粒动态分配给 prefill 或 decode；另一篇提出用统一聚合-分离架构，通过可配置滑块控制 prefill-heavy 与 decode-heavy 实例的比例及块大小。
[paper-013] · 摘要；[paper-019] · 摘要

在资源划分的粒度上，前者是芯片级：四芯粒 MCM 中的芯粒可动态指派给 prefill 或 decode；后者是实例级：区分 prefill-heavy（预填充快、解码干扰高）与 decode-heavy（解码干扰低、预填充慢）两类 GPU 实例，并调节二者比例。
[paper-013] · 摘要；[paper-019] · 摘要

前者还引入跨集群注意力数据流，把部分注意力计算转移到另一集群以减少依赖流量；后者在混合模式下采用“延迟转移”，把已满足 SLO 的请求所占 GPU 资源选择性让给有违约风险的请求，并由解码调度与长度感知的预填充调度协同完成。
[paper-013] · 摘要；[paper-019] · 摘要

适用条件方面，前者面向 PD 分离式 LLM 推理的专用加速器场景，摘要给出在 GPT-2、OPT、Llama 3.2 上的有效吞吐数据，并称相对四芯粒 PD 聚合基线有额外提升；后者面向需要在任意 TTFT/TPOT SLO 组合下优化 goodput 的服务系统，摘要称在均衡 SLO 下 goodput 最高提升 77%。
[paper-013] · 摘要；[paper-019] · 摘要

两篇的评估基线不同（前者为四芯粒 PD 聚合基线，后者为现有最先进系统），当前材料未说明二者在相同硬件、模型与负载下的对照实验，因此无法就吞吐或延迟做公平的横向比较。
[paper-013] · 摘要；[paper-019] · 摘要

当前材料未说明两篇论文在负载突增时的具体重配置时延、切换开销，也未说明二者对输入输出长度分布的敏感性；这些细节无法从摘要核验。
[paper-013] · 摘要；[paper-019] · 摘要

citations.quote: TaiChi uses a unified disaggregation-aggregation architecture with differentiated-capability GPU instances: prefill-heavy (fast prefill, high-interference decode) and decode-heavy (low-interference decode, slow prefill). Three configurable sliders control the ratio between these instances and their chunk sizes. TaiChi adapts to various SLO regimes by adjusting sliders.

citations.title: Prefill-Decode Aggregation or Disaggregation? Unifying Both for Goodput-Optimized LLM Serving
citations.quote: When TTFT constraints are tight, TaiChi resembles a PD aggregation configuration; when TPOT dominates, it adapts toward PD disaggregation.

citations.title: Prefill-Decode Aggregation or Disaggregation? Unifying Both for Goodput-Optimized LLM Serving
citations.quote: Crucially, under balanced SLOs, TaiChi enables a hybrid mode for superior goodput. The key innovation behind this hybrid mode is latency shifting: selectively reallocating GPU resources from requests that meet SLOs to those at risk of violation, maximizing the number of SLO-satisfied requests.

citations.title: Prefill-Decode Aggregation or Disaggregation? Unifying Both for Goodput-Optimized LLM Serving
citations.quote: This fine-grained latency shifting is orchestrated by two scheduling mechanisms: flowing decode scheduling to control TPOTs and length-aware prefill scheduling to manage TTFTs, which jointly optimize request assignment.

messages.content: 基于当前研究材料，提出两个值得进一步验证的问题。每个问题说明已有依据、尚未解决的缺口，以及可执行的对照实验。不要把实验设想写成已有结论。

**在Prefill-Decode分离的多模型服务中，共享预填充模块（如PrefillShare）能否在保持或降低尾延迟的同时，减少聚合预填充负载？**

PrefillShare摘要指出，每个模型冗余执行预填充并维护独立KV缓存，增加了聚合预填充负载并加剧预填充-解码干扰，从而恶化尾延迟。然而，共享预填充模块对尾延迟和聚合负载的实际影响尚未量化，且缺乏与独立预填充的对照实验。

可这样分析。构建多模型分离服务测试环境，分别部署独立预填充和共享预填充模块，在相同请求负载下测量尾延迟和聚合预填充计算量，通过消融实验验证共享机制的效果。

**在Prefill-Decode分离架构中，基于SLO和请求特征（输入/输出长度）动态分配P/D硬件资源，相比静态比例分配，能否在满足SLO约束下提高总吞吐量？**

SLO-Aware Compute Resource Allocation摘要指出，目前缺乏确定最优P/D硬件资源数量的方法，且需考虑总吞吐量、SLO和请求特征。动态分配策略的有效性尚未与静态分配进行对照验证。

可这样分析。实现动态资源分配算法，根据实时请求特征和SLO约束调整P/D资源比例，与固定比例分配在相同负载下对比，评估吞吐量和SLO满足率。
